name: Endpoint snapshot equality without temporal lineage
scope: Endpoint/signature equality is insufficient for the strict episode relation.

name: Detached exact temporal copy
scope: Exact endpoint, package-like, and autonomy-like success do not imply a strict overlap corridor.

name: Holonomy without endogenous arrow
scope: Noncommuting reversible route updates do not supply an endogenous record arrow.

name: Externally scheduled temporal shadow
scope: Runtime temporal progress maintained by an essential scheduler collapses after withdrawal.

name: Stable tick phase without genuine progress
scope: Tick viability and phase stability do not imply temporal progress.

name: Current-equal but predictively different routes
scope: A present quotient can collide while a continuation probe separates routes; route memory repairs the collision.

name: Nonzero clock-translation holonomy
scope: A nonzero cycle translation obstructs one route-independent global now.

name: Local clause success without a global package witness
scope: Individually accepted local witnesses can disagree on a shared coordinate.

name: Public/report-perfect collision with hidden mismatch
scope: The same finite public report can be emitted by states with different hidden structural facts.

name: Small scalar residual hiding a failed hard gate
scope: A mean binary defect at or below one tenth can coexist with a nonnegotiable failed gate.

name: Exact symmetric fork without an invariant unique selector
scope: A fixed-point-free target-swap symmetry supports relation-valued branches but no invariant singleton choice.

name: Temporal gap followed by an equivalent resumed stream
scope: Equivalent realized endpoints do not satisfy the strict no-gap temporal corridor when an internal stage is unrealized.

name: Finite successful trace without indefinite liveness
scope: A deterministic system can satisfy a nontrivial finite live prefix and still inevitably exhaust its budget.

name: Same-carrier re-encoding control
scope: A nonidentity representation map on one fixed carrier is not a distinct-carrier transport instance.

name: Branchwise preservation without recombination preservation
scope: Two joint relations can have identical branch marginals while differing in their recombination structure.
